dedupe_keys.name: additional data for settling velocities of tire and road wear particles analyzing finely graded density fractions of samples from a road simulator and a highway tunnel

description: TU Berlin and Helmholtz researchers publish settling measurements for tire and road wear particles. Zenodo provides four archives free under CC BY 4.0, covering single-particle observations, density-fraction distributions, composed particle distributions and correction code. Measurements and distributions are referenced to fifteen degrees Celsius and zero salinity, with Python corrections for other conditions. These inputs can calibrate particle-transport and deposition components in simulations of road runoff and receiving waters. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these experiments. Coverage is selected laboratory particles, not the full range of road wear under field conditions. Particle preparation, density assumptions and transfer to turbulent flows introduce uncertainty. A separate restricted deposit describes the same experimental family. No archive was downloaded, correction script executed or settling distribution recomputed.
